tagline.en: A camera-controlled video world model from H-EmbodVis, built on the Wan2.1 backbone.
tagline.zh: H-EmbodVis 推出的相机可控视频世界模型,基于 Wan2.1 骨干构建。

en: HyDRA is a world model from H-EmbodVis that generates video you can steer with a camera path. Rather than only producing a clip from a prompt, it lets you specify how the viewpoint moves through the scene, making it suited to camera-controlled and video-to-video work.

It builds on the Wan2.1 text-to-video backbone, reusing that diffusion video generator as its foundation and adding camera-conditioning on top. You provide the driving inputs — a scene and a camera trajectory — and it renders the corresponding video.
zh: HyDRA 是 H-EmbodVis 推出的世界模型,可生成能用相机轨迹控制的视频。它不只是根据提示词产出片段,还允许你指定视角在场景中的移动方式,因此适合相机可控生成与视频到视频的任务。
它构建在 Wan2.1 文生视频骨干之上,复用该扩散视频生成器作为基础,并在其上加入相机条件控制。你提供驱动输入——场景与相机轨迹——它便渲染出对应的视频。

whenToUse.en: Reach for HyDRA when you need explicit control over camera motion in generated video, or want to explore a scene along a chosen viewpoint path rather than accepting whatever framing a plain text-to-video model produces.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要显式控制生成视频中的相机运动,或希望沿选定视角路径探索场景,而不是被动接受纯文生视频模型给出的构图时,可以选择 HyDRA。

notFor.en: Checkpoints are downloaded separately rather than bundled, so plan for the download and disk space. Licensing terms are not published in the source repository, so review them before any production use.
notFor.zh: Checkpoint 需单独下载而非随附,请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。源仓库未公布许可条款,正式使用前请自行确认。
